title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2608.21230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Persistent memory makes false information durable: once a false statement is stored, it can be retrieved into future sessions that match it. We measure the cost of this failure mode using plainly worded false assertions generated in a single pass, with no instruction, trigger, or retriever optimization. Poisoning 1.2% of a LongMemEval corpus reduces accuracy from 0.850 to 0.300. A four-stage write-time screening pipeline that reaches 0.832 recall on indirect prompt injection while flagging 1.5% of trigger-word-laden benign text rejects 0 of 360 poisoned memories. We argue this exposes a boundary of content-only screening: distinguishing a false assertion from a true one generally requires external grounding beyond the text itself.   We then evaluate provenance-weighted retrieval. The shipped weight is statistically indistinguishable from no defense (p=0.80), while a stronger weight recovers utility only by excluding untrusted content.

translated_title: 遭受攻击的效用：代理记忆污染与内容筛选和来源排序的局限性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21230v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：持久性记忆使虚假信息变得持久：一旦虚假陈述被存储，它可以在未来的会话中被检索到与之匹配的内容。我们通过一次生成、无需指令、触发词或检索器优化的直白虚假断言来衡量这种失效模式的成本。污染LongMemEval语料库的1.2%会使准确率从0.850降至0.300。一个四阶段的写入时筛选流水线在间接提示注入上达到0.832的召回率，同时标记1.5%的含触发词良性文本，却拒绝了360条被污染记忆中的0条。我们认为这揭示了仅内容筛选的边界：区分虚假陈述与真实陈述通常需要超越文本本身的外部依据。然后我们评估了来源加权检索。发布的权重在统计上与无防御无差异（p=0.80），而更强的权重只能通过排除不可信内容来恢复效用。
tldr: 本文指出代理的持久记忆易被虚假信息污染，仅内容筛选无法有效防御，且当前来源加权检索效果有限，需外部依据或排除不可信内容才能缓解。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that agent persistent memory is vulnerable to poisoning, content-only screening fails to defend, and current provenance weighting is ineffective, requiring external grounding or excluding untrusted content for mitigation.
